name: sktbranding
description: SKT Branding - Executive Luxury Brand Architecture & Designer Studio MERN Monorepo

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), { execSync } = require('child_process'); if (fs.existsSync('client/node_modules/vite')) { try { execSync('npm --prefix client run build && node -e \"const f=require(\'fs\'); f.cpSync(\'client/dist\', \'dist\', {recursive:true});\"', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } catch(e) { console.warn('Build fallback:', e.message); } } else { console.log('[Build] Using pre-built production dist bundle from repository.'); }"
scripts.build:local: npm --prefix client run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true});"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
